title: Lakhanpur (J&K) Selected as First Town for PM SVANidhi Street Food Hub
summary: Establishes modern street food hub under Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs initiative.

blocks.content: Establishes modern street food hub under Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs initiative.

items: Financial Grant: ₹4 crore financial assistance released in 3 installments (30:50:20 ratio).
ULB Incentive: Urban local bodies notifying street vending plans receive ₹25 lakh bonus incentive.
Partner Agencies: Coordinated by MoHUA, Ministry of Tourism, and FSSAI.

blocks.title: Static Background & GK Context
blocks.summary: PM SVANidhi launched June 1, 2020 by MoHUA | FSSAI HQ: New Delhi.

blocks.title: Exam Trap & Statutory Distinction
blocks.content: PM SVANidhi street food hub grant (₹4 crore) vs ULB incentive (₹25 lakh).
